description: Submit the final report of your ticket with one result per acceptance criterion. Your worktree is committed and the ticket becomes Resolved. This ends your run.

acceptance.description: One result per acceptance criterion of the ticket (all of them).

items.description: Result for one acceptance criterion of the ticket.

evidence.description: Where the evidence is: a test name, file path, command output or explanation.

items.description: A produced artifact (file, diff, commit, log, ...).

beyond_ticket.description:
What you changed beyond the ticket's ask (a refactor, a rename, a new dependency, a file it did not need), each
with why. The reviewer reads the diff against it: an extra not listed here is a reason to reopen (ADR-148).

checks_not_run.description:
Checks that apply to this work but were not run (a test suite, a browser check …), each with why. The handover
report lists them beside the checks the runs' logs show (ADR-147).

confidence.description: Your confidence that every criterion is met, 0..1.

extension.description: Template specific section, validated against the ticket's report template.

summary.description: What was done, at most 800 characters.

tests_changed.description: Tests you changed, skipped, loosened or removed, each with why (ADR-148).

title: submit_report
